title: Felisun
description: Turns the sun into Felix from Stray Kids.
body:
# Felisun
Felisun turns Felix from _Stray Kids_ into the sun. That's all it does.
## Why would you want this?
Felisun is for STAYs (_Stray Kids_ fans) to celebrate Felix as a member of _Stray Kids_ every time the sun rises! Isn't that fun?
> You might see the sun as visually larger when applying this resource pack. I tried my best, okay?

> If your shader overwrites the sun (most do), then Felisun's sun texture will not be rendered as the sun.

My friend made me make this. You're welcome.
